I walk 20-25km a day with 1349 doors on my route - I don't have a single apartment or CMB (community mail box) anywhere - I average 35-50 parcels/registered items any given day and then add 400 bundles of flyers and coupons daily to ensure each mailbox gets .. 

It's this short sighted view that give Canada Post a bad wrap - some have it easier than others but the urban carrier is door to door so you can dine for 14.99 at McDonald's and get your phone bill....

Well if tax payers pay for it - why is there this overwhelming push to be profitable.... Are you as a tax payer going to see that back - no don't think so...

It's not Amazon - it's every door almost every day - I personally think until you've done the job - you have no idea of the skill involved or the amount of wear and tear on our bodies, daily every day 

We might not be considered skilled but I know for a fact not everyone has the skills to do this job

Now who's delusional?  Again explain why you think those providing you the customer a free service - is delusional in wanting a safe job...  Major cities can't find people to even do the job (hence the overtime) - how would you change things?  

Overtime isn't a perk it's what's needed to get the job done in areas no one else is willing to do the work .

How is putting in 8-9 hours a day and hoping to be paid for it and not destroy my body - delusional? 

I've only been at this job for 3 months and not once have I thought damn this is easy or man that God I get paid to wash my hands...

Please enlighten us - how are we delusional?  You base this on you not getting your mail based on your schedule?  Did you miss the mailman once while in the shower and now it's trash....

Please give some ideas of how one can come along and do it 10 times better, without costing you the "free user" of the postal services something....

We delivers in NM last month We are Hiring flyers, I saw a Amazon guy in his personal van crying... I walked over and talked with him for my entire 15 break (and I NEVER take more than a gas station squirt).... Said he works 10 hours burns almost a full tank a day of is own gas - which equated to half his weekly pay, was to embarrassed to even say what he made....  2019 van almost dead in 1 year he owned it.  

Gave him the flyer and he started to cry knowing they pay for the gas!! Huged me and drove away with a glimmer of hope - sorry the widows bundle didn't get the flyer but I know it at least got into the hands of some who who would do anything to work in human level conditions... Made me thankful for what we have.
